package.name: wojtek_perception_bringup
package.description:
Perception pipeline bringup for wojtek: the RealSense D435 depth and colour streams with their measured post-processing settings, and the camera-to-body extrinsics. What is built on those streams (the local costmap, obstacle perception) lives in the navigation packages.
Composes third-party packages (the realsense2_camera driver, tf2_ros) around this package's measured configuration, which is why it is a *_bringup and not a launch file inside a node package.
